Refer to Item 8.01 below for information on the Partnership&#8217;s Transactional NAV. </p></td></tr></table> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The offer and sale of the Units were exempt from the registration under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#8220;Securities Act&#8221;), pursuant to Section&#160;4(a)(2) and Regulation D thereunder. The Units were offered and sold to investors who were both (a)&#160;accredited investors (as defined in Regulation D under the Securities Act) and (b)&#160;qualified purchasers (as defined in the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended, and the rules thereunder). </p> <p style="font-size:18pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>

Description of Business&#8212;Valuation &#8211; Net Asset Value Calculation and Valuation Day</span>&#8221; of the Partnership&#8217;s <a href="http://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2060316/000119312526402689/d293378d1012ga.htm">Amendment No.&#160;1 to its Registration Statement on Form 10 filed on September&#160;25, 2026</a> (the &#8220;Registration Statement&#8221;). Transactional NAV is based on the <span style="white-space:nowrap">month-end</span> values of the Partnership&#8217;s investments, the addition of the value of any other assets (such as cash on hand, without duplication), and the deduction of any liabilities, including the allocation/accrual of the management fee and carried interest and the deduction of expenses attributable to certain Series (such as applicable servicing fees), in all cases as determined in accordance with the procedures as may be established from time to time by the Partnership&#8217;s investment manager (the &#8220;Investment Manager&#8221;), in its sole discretion. The Investment Manager has agreed to bear (without reimbursement) the Partnership&#8217;s Eligible Operating Expenses (as defined in the Registration Statement) exceeding 0.60%&#160;per annum of the Transactional NAV on each <span style="white-space:nowrap">month-end</span> of each annual period through December&#160;31, 2026 (the &#8220;Expense Threshold&#8221;).&#160;For Transactional NAV, organization and offering expenses advanced on our behalf by the Investment Manager are recognized as a reduction to Transactional NAV ratably over 60 months following the first closing. Transactional NAV generally will not reflect contingent tax liabilities of intermediate entities if such liabilities are not reasonably expected to be triggered upon the realization of the underlying investment through a sale of interests of such intermediate entities. Transactional NAV per Unit is expected to differ from the calculation of NAV as reflected in the financial statements of the Partnership. </p> <p style="font-size:18pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>
